label: Auto Yes
blockedByContractTitle: The running contract sets autoYes.mode: off, so Auto Yes answers no prompt in this session even while ON.
releasedByRestartTitle: A server restart turned Auto Yes off (it is not turned back on automatically). Turn it on again if this session should keep answering. Shown until the original grant would have expired, or until you toggle it.
multipleChoiceAutoSelect: Questions with options → follow "How questions are answered" below
appliesOnlyToCurrent: * Auto Yes applies only to the currently selected {toolName} session. It does not affect other CLI tools.

answerModes.recommended: Answer questions with the recommended option (Recommended)

answerModeDescriptions.recommended: A question from the agent is answered automatically with the option marked as recommended (or the default option when none is)
answerModeDescriptions.careful: A question from the agent is not answered automatically; you answer it from the answer panel

answerModePermissionNote: Either way, permission confirmations (editing files, running commands, and so on) are answered automatically ("allow this once" is chosen).

answerModeBadgeTitle.recommended: Questions are answered with the recommended option (Recommended). Permission confirmations are answered too
answerModeBadgeTitle.careful: Questions are left for you to answer (Careful). Permission confirmations are answered automatically

riskWarning: Automatic responses may result in unintended operations (such as file deletion or overwriting). Please use only after fully understanding the implications.
disclaimerText: The developers assume no responsibility for any issues arising from the use of Auto Yes mode. Use at your own risk.
stopPatternDescription: Auto-Yes will be automatically stopped when terminal output matches this pattern
patternTooLong: Pattern must be 500 characters or less
stopPatternMatched: Auto-Yes was automatically stopped because the stop condition was matched
consecutiveErrorsStopped: Auto-Yes stopped due to consecutive errors
regexTipWordBoundary: … match whole word only (prevents partial match)
